experiment.hypothesis: After a sustained 10-hour uptrend in BTC-USD hourly close prices above $1,000,000, the price will reverse in the next hour.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: For each hour in 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31, if the BTC-USD hourly close price was above $1,000,000 for at least 10 consecutive hours, then in the next hour, the close price must drop by at least 0.5% — otherwise, the hypothesis is falsified.
